summary: Public projects created on 24 March 2026: 7 repos.
intro: Red alert tooling for Israel runs through several repositories: notification projects, a relay proxy for Homefront Command data, physical alert outputs, and a monitoring stack. Other work covers prediction analysis for real world events, a template for separate developer and user CLAUDE.md files, and a Hebrew tech vocabulary collection.
